The Prophet was once bewitched, so that he imagined he had done things he had not done.
Bewitched, the Prophet learns in a dream that Labid bin Al-A'sam worked the magic with a comb and hair placed in Dharwan's well, and Allah cures him.
Labid bin Al-A'sam worked magic on the Prophet till Allah revealed it lay in Dharwan's well; avoid shirk and witchcraft; some eloquence works like magic; Ajwa dates guard against magic.
Lubaid bin Asam worked magic on the Prophet with a comb and hair hidden in Dharwan's well; Allah revealed it and cured him, and he would not spread the evil.
Bewitched by Labid bin Al-A'sam so he thought he had done what he had not, the Prophet invoked Allah, learned from two men where the spell lay, and was cured.
